title: Identifying elevated risk for future pain crises in sickle-cell disease using photoplethysmogram patterns measured during sleep: A machine learning approach
summary: Sleep heart-rate/PPG models predict future vaso-occlusive pain crises in children/adolescents with sickle-cell disease; a stacked model and cross-validation are evaluated against a random baseline. Scope is exploratory home-monitoring risk prediction, not clinical outcome prevention. Methods describes 252 SCD subjects, feature selection, cross-validation and held-out prediction against baseline; retrospective cohort caveats retained.
ai_technology: Stacked ML classifiers use overnight heart-rate and photoplethysmogram features to predict subsequent VOC pain crises.
